text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand images and videos. One important task is image recognition, which allows a computer to identify what is in a picture, such as a person, an animal, or an object. Another key task is object detection, where the computer not only recognises objects but also finds where they are in the image. These technologies have many practical applications in our daily lives. For example, self-driving cars use computer vision to detect pedestrians, other vehicles, and traffic signs, so they can drive safely. Computer vision is also used in security cameras, medical imaging, and face recognition on smartphones. As technology improves, computer vision will become even more useful in the future.
